location_name: Lower Static District, transit-line noodle stall
description_public: Rain sheets off a cracked awning; the noodle stall's the only warm light on the block. A contact is late.
environment: Wet pavement, distant traffic drone, flickering signage.
objectives_public: Meet the contact and get the job details
dm_notes: DM truth (dm_private): the 'client' is a shell for Ashvale Dynamics staging a recovery of data it itself leaked, not a theft. None of this is established to the players yet.
